# Lifespan purchase: +1 year expectancy per buy, 50 buys max.
xar_buy_lifespan_effect = {
	change_global_variable = {
		name = xa_lifespan_bought
		add = 1
	}

		limit = { global_var:xa_lifespan_bought = 1 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_lifespan_01 }

# Parameterized floor(log2($SRC$)) into global var $VAR$.
# Call: xar_log2_floor_effect = { SRC = gold VAR = xa_l_gold }
xar_log2_floor_effect = {
	set_global_variable = {
		name = $VAR$
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 2 }
		change_global_variable = {
			name = $VAR$
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 4 }
		change_global_variable = {
			name = $VAR$
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 8 }
		change_global_variable = {
			name = $VAR$
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 16 }
		change_global_variable = {
			name = $VAR$
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 32 }
		change_global_variable = {
			name = $VAR$
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { $SRC$ >= 64 }

			name = $VAR$
